central_finding: D012 repairs D011's generic harbor drift with route specificity, but the route becomes directions plus abstract lyric closure rather than enough resistant object pressure.
strengths: Broadway/State Street/Coast Guard route facts give stronger source pressure than D011's generic waterfront atmosphere.
The no-value/runtime-gap hinge remains alive in 'No value came back. / Water did.'
The draft keeps NOAA tables out of the poem body and maintains the no-live-reading boundary.
risks: The route behaves like directions rather than a material object.
The opening and ending over-personify/explain the harbor.
The first-zero pressure remains partly conceptual through phrases like old arithmetic.
revision_instruction: Do not promote D012. Create at most one bounded successor that re-anchors in the NOAA benchmark object itself: tidal station disk, concrete loading dock, blue brick guard house, and the first-zero/no-value hinge.
required_successor_pressure: first zero retained without poem-body Station Datum
